notes.title: Samurai Sword VR - Now Available!
notes.notes:
[h1] Samurai Sword VR is now available for purchase on Steam[/h1]
Through the fields of Japan straddling his horse, through the rivers of villages on his boat, the samurai uses his katana, shuriken, and kunai to protect honor and integrity during ancient times of war.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27498977/43e3ba0555a2db27ad144ab61ee76593ad412c8d.png[/img]

Clear all stages to unlock the final stage and an epic boss battle.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27498977/dad881a324a32ec8ed5162bb7fe4a2c74585630b.png[/img]

Compete with others around the world to achieve the highest score.  Slice your way through each stage and conquer anything that stands in your path!
